principles: Use explicit metadata or filename prefix before image-gate predictions.
Use image-gate routing only as a fallback for inputs without source metadata.
Route to a specialized expert only when confidence clears the configured threshold.
Fallback to shape1 for unknown, mixed, or low-confidence inputs.
notes: kurip_dirty_ep20 adapts to kurip but introduces visible screentone/noise artifacts.
Single-tile image-gate predictions are not reliable enough for automatic expert routing.
